Jordan Lee

arguments.subject: Re: Late Shipment for PO-55120
arguments.body:
Dear Priya,

I sincerely apologize for the delay in the shipment for PO-55120. I understand the inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your understanding.

The new delivery date for the shipment is scheduled for November 3. To show our commitment to resolving this issue, we are also offering you a 10% credit on the invoice for this order.

If you would prefer, we can also explore the option of splitting the shipment, with 600 units being sent via air to arrive by October 23. This would allow you to receive a portion of the order sooner.

Please let me know if this works for you or if there is anything else I can do to assist you. I value your partnership and am committed to ensuring your satisfaction.

Best regards,
Jordan Lee
VP Operations, Northwind Logistics
